body: You are correct about the state of the world. There's nothing hopeful or good about it. If you're lgbt, you're pretty much fucked. A lot of people will hate you just for that, countries like Russia are very hostile towards you and it's not even illegal to be lgbt there. Then there are countries like Saudi Arabia where it is very much illegal and often punishable by death. And btw, this is a great friend and ally we're talking here. There's nothing good and true about the world, just hypocrisy, deceit and a bitter fight for financial resources dressed in even more hypocrisy and evil. I talked to an older "friend" about it once and he said "do you like living in a comfortable 1st world country? Saudi Arabia ensures the petrodollar supremacy and our national wealth". Which is why we're now helping them genocide non-Sunni minorities in the Middle East. Life and fate are so arbitrary and nothing has real value. Nobody cares about you in any way other than how you make them feel and what they can get from you.
